comparison.objective: Select the dry mould and bimanually lift, carry, and pour a crucible using its shank; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Hazard recognition, two-handle load transport, and controlled pouring versus precision adjustment-tool use and iterative impact testing.
comparison.success_condition: Rigid beads poured into the dry mould without touching the crucible or choosing the wet mould versus repeatable non-bottoming stops. Pour quantity/tolerance is unspecified and no separate specs exist.
comparison.reason: Foundry-safe material transfer does not test damping adjustment or lock retention.
